services.desc: Discover the enchanting beauty of the Muskoka Lakes with Sunset Cruises aboard Peerless II - a historic vessel proudly cruising these waters since 1946. Just two hours north of Toronto, departing from the iconic hub of Port Carling.Private charters are welcomed at attractive rates. Owned and operated by Captain R S Potts, born and raised in Muskoka withover 45 years on the water and 40 years as a professional licensed captain.Peerless II explores places the larger boats can’t. blurb: Guests board the Peerless II at Lock Street, Port Carling, for cruises on Lake Muskoka, Lake Rosseau, and Lake Joseph. Cruises include sightseeing, live commentary, and special event cruises such as Thanksgiving and all-day lake tours. Private charters are available for weddings, corporate events, and celebrations.
